entry.title: feat(poe): add missing Gemini models, refresh Poe Google entries (#9519)
entry.content:
feat(poe): add missing Gemini models, refresh Poe Google entries (#9519)

* feat(poe): add missing Gemini models, refresh Poe Google entries

Add Google-hosted Gemini models listed by Poe but missing from
providers/poe/models/google/: gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gemini-3.6-flash,
gemini-3.7-flash, gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-omni-1.1-flash, plus new lab
metadata in models/google/gemini-omni-1.1-flash.toml.

Refresh existing Poe Google entries and provider.toml:
- costs converted to exact USD/MTok (pricing x1e6)
- thinking_level enums filed as effort values (verified live)
- temperature=false -> true: live probes show chat-completions validates
  temperature (0..2), so entries no longer override temperature = true
- pdf dropped from input: Poe's model list omits it from
  input_modalities, so Poe doesn't accept PDF input even though the
  underlying model does

Adds packages/core/script/poe-reasoning-audit.py, used for the live
verification. EmpirioLabs TTS, nano-banana, veo and lyria entries
skipped for simplicity (spent enough time on this PR).

* clean poe-comments from google-specific info

* docs(poe): cite live 3.5-flash input_modalities payload (no audio)

* Delete packages/core/script/poe-reasoning-audit.py

---------

Co-authored-by: Aiden Cline <63023139+rekram1-node@users.noreply.github.com>

entry.title: Add Boundless provider (20 models) (#7342)
entry.content:
Add Boundless provider (20 models) (#7342)

* feat(boundless): add Boundless provider and 15 models

* fix(boundless): drop restated output limits, note catalog-matched modalities

* fix(boundless): drop effort 'none' on the three always-reasoning models

* feat(boundless): sync with the current rate card

Add Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6 Sol, GLM-5.3, MiMo-V2.6 Flash and
MiMo-V2.6 Pro. Drop MiMo-V2.5, which is no longer served. GLM-5.2 and
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash now carry the 1,048,576 context the host serves, and Kimi
K3 matches its base context, so its override is gone.

Claude Opus 5.5 and GLM-5.3 reject reasoning_effort 'none' with a 400.

* fix(boundless): list only the reasoning levels each model has

The gateway takes reasoning_effort none|low|medium|high and drops anything
else, so each file now keeps the levels that the gateway and the model's lab
entry or OpenRouter peer share. MiniMax M3, MiMo-V2.6 and Qwen3.6 are on/off
only, so they carry a toggle. Drop the header comments that only restated
the PR description.
